literal: Of a casket joining like even if joined, will not unite indeed, internal enmity afflicted family.
translation: Even if they appear joined like a casket and its lid, a family afflicted by internal enmity will never truly unite.
modern: செப்பிற்கும் அதன் மூடிக்கும் உள்ள பொருத்தத்தைப் போல வெளிப்பார்வைக்கு ஒன்றாகச் சேர்ந்திருந்தாலும், உட்பகை உள்ள குடி உண்மையில் ஒன்றுபடாது.
explanation: This couplet uses the striking image of a small box or casket (செப்பு) and its lid. When closed, the lid and the box fit together perfectly on the outside, but they remain two separate pieces. Similarly, a family or group suffering from internal enmity might look united to the outside world. However, their hearts remain divided, and they will never truly become one.
